prologue.title: Terrain first, trails that can change
prologue.overview: This branch builds a 3D hex-path laboratory and ports the round-11 open-ground generator: erosion shapes a region, a ranked window supplies immutable terrain, and a separate layout creates nodes and creek-constrained trails. Regeneration reruns that layout with pins, preserving terrain and crossing landmarks. Staged edits are the first implementation; inline Review delta notes identify the unstaged adjustments against that baseline.
key_changes: Region → Terrain → Layout → Board separates physical ground, mutable arrangements, and Bevy presentation.
Uplift, priority flood, drainage accumulation, erosion, and creep replace noise hills.
Window ranking uses traced creeks, main-creek fords, natural views, relief, and river penalties.
Typed nodes, Dijkstra routing, tease retries, biconnected loop checks, banks, and ports build the network.
Partial regeneration and Fear preserve different pins; node IDs and cards survive regeneration.
Unstaged review repairs focus, marker semantics, and camera scale invalidation, and removes route history.
Read the review-level teaching notes for the complete algorithm walkthrough; the chapters group the actual code by concern.
risks: Generation runs synchronously; one cached region avoids repeat erosion for a matching key.
Spacing, displacement, and loop creation have fallbacks or guarded attempts; output counts and held teases can vary.
Outer-margin creek links may lack a shared side; the unstaged change documents that existing limitation.
Walking, woodland sight density, and actual trail smoothing remain outside this pass.
Small seeded and selected-schedule tests cover specific properties; no fresh test run was performed while authoring this story.

chapters.title: The laboratory and its Bevy boundary
chapters.summary: Resources hold settings and results; screen systems turn a generated Board into an orbitable preview, while the panel offers terrain replacement, fresh layouts, partial regeneration, and Fear.

chapters.title: Water carves the regional landscape
chapters.summary: Repeated uplift, priority flood, steepest descent, accumulated drainage, stream-power cuts, and creep produce a large region whose outlets lie on every boundary.

chapters.title: A playable window and two lattices
chapters.summary: Candidate ranking selects a useful landscape; shared corners carry trails, centre-to-centre creeks close the sides they cross, and a finer raster supplies immutable board heights.

chapters.title: Landmarks, tease pairs, and pinned identity
chapters.summary: Suitability and ranked views guide typed placement; the same seeded layout pipeline learns walking order, replaces broken tease pairs, and regenerates around preserved node identities and trails.

chapters.title: Routes, crossings, independent loops
chapters.summary: Dijkstra and a greedy spanner build trails under the tease guard; union-find selects useful crossings, biconnected blocks distinguish real alternate routes, and bank and port passes repair missing connections.

chapters.title: What the headless fixture exercises
chapters.summary: Selected schedule stepping checks board replacement and direct unload behaviour; the unstaged fixture adds the view resource required by the new focus repair.
